nodes.label: Phone as a paired browser on the tailnet
nodes.rationale: The Mac hosts; the phone pairs by QR (one-use, 10 min) that sets a year-long HttpOnly cookie; non-Mac requests need the cookie or get 401; managing access is Mac-only so a paired phone can't mint more phones. The phone posts as Guy through the Mac for now.

nodes.label: Phone layout (chat owns the screen, sheets for panels)
nodes.rationale: Title bar and dock gone, sidebar becomes its own screen, room header collapses to a ⋯ menu, agent strip hidden unless it needs you, panels become full-screen sheets, long-press to react, 16px composer text to avoid iOS zoom.

nodes.label: Live dictation pipe (/api/live WebSocket → Parakeet on the Mac)
nodes.rationale: Phone captures 16 kHz mono PCM, streams over /api/live, Mac runs Parakeet in-process and streams partials back; same pipe as desktop. iOS only allows the mic in a secure context, so HTTPS via tailscale serve is required and the phone must re-pair since the https origin is a different site.

edges.source_location: Security: phone as its own rKey device key
